blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.
blocks.zh: 世界模式已成为体现大赦国际的一个有希望的范例,但现有系统在模式及其支持的职能方面往往仍然支离破碎。 特别是视觉动力学,几何结构,可执行动作通常通过单独的界面或下游模块进行组合,而不是在一个共享动力学模型中共同代表并演化. 在这部作品中,我们介绍了"智者-WM"(Thinker-WM),这是一个统一的多模式世界模型,它通过一个共享的中间体"统一动力变形器"(United Dynamics Transformer)与模式特有编码器和解码器,联合了模型并生成了RGB,度量深度和机器人动作. 该模型在代表层面实现多模式统一:外观、几何和动作被转化为共同的动态代表,并由共同参数共同演变,同时保留其独特的产出结构。 同样的参数化支持多种功能,包括联合视频-动作生成,世界预测,政策推论,动作有条件的生成,视频-动作生成,反向动态. 为了检查共享的表示是否捕捉到与动作相关的信息,我们引入了轻量级运动探测器,显示被冻结的视觉表现包含可被取回的运动信息. Thinker-WM接受过关于多种元件的培训,包括大约20K小时的自负式视频、10K小时的真机器人数据以及1K小时的模拟数据,包括大约4K小时的真机器人数据,并配有对齐的深度监督。 广泛的实验表明,在体现的世界模式评价中,表现良好。 Thinker-WM在EWMBench,WorldOlympiad和WorldArena上排名第一,而受控研究则进一步证明了动作调节,几何相互作用,以及共享代表范围内的多功能训练的好处.

blocks.en: World models aim to learn how an environment evolves over time, enabling an agent to anticipate the consequences of its interventions rather than react only to the current observation. Early work developed compact latent simulators for planning and reinforcement learning [ 8 , 9 ] , while recent approaches increasingly leverage large-scale generative models with broader visual and temporal priors [ 11 , 5 , 38 , 33 , 24 ] . For embodied intelligence, however, predicting future appearance alone is insufficient: the evolution of the world is simultaneously reflected in visual observations, physical geometry, executable actions, and task intent. Actions change the environment, the resulting state constrains subsequent actions, and task intent determines the desired evolution. This motivates world-action models (WAMs), which jointly model future world states and the actions that produce them [ 3 , 21 , 45 , 39 ] .
blocks.zh: 世界模型旨在了解一个环境如何随时间演变,使一个代理人能够预见其干预行动的后果,而不是仅仅对目前的观察作出反应。 早期工作为规划和强化学习开发了紧凑的潜在模拟器[8、9],而最近的方法越来越多地利用具有更广泛的视觉和时间前科的大规模基因模型[11、5、38、33、24]。 然而,对于已体现的智能来说,仅预测未来外观是不够的:世界的演变同时体现在视觉观测,物理几何,可执行的行动,以及任务意图上. 动作改变环境,所形成的状态会制约后继行动,任务意图决定所期望的发展. 这激发了世界行动模式(WAMS),它们共同模拟未来世界国家以及产生它们的行动[3、21、45、39]。

blocks.en: Recent WAMs have made substantial progress by bringing video and action modeling into a common generative framework. Different approaches, however, place the coupling at different levels. Some systems compose modality-specific experts or maintain distinct processing pathways for different modalities [ 3 , 21 ] . Others use a shared transformer and unify video and action through diffusion or noise configurations, while retaining separate modality channels [ 45 , 6 , 14 ] . Omnimodal world models further broaden the set of modeled modalities, but may retain embodiment-specific projections around a shared backbone [ 25 ] . Geometry has also been introduced into world-action modeling, for example through geometric-semantic prediction or lightweight spatial representations supervised by future depth [ 19 , 17 , 37 ] . These approaches demonstrate that combining complementary signals can improve embodied world modeling. Nevertheless, the modalities are often connected through interfaces, conditioning mechanisms, or modality-specific parameterizations rather than being expressed within a common representation that jointly carries future-world dynamics. This raises a fundamental question: where should multimodal unification take place in a general world-action model? We argue that the key is not merely to make multiple modalities available to the same network, but to let them evolve within a shared representation in which their common structure can be learned directly.
blocks.zh: 近期的WAM通过将视频和行动模型引入一个共同的基因框架而取得了重大进展. 然而,不同的做法将结合置于不同层面。 一些系统由特定模式的专家组成,或为不同模式保持不同的处理途径[3、21]。 另一些则使用共享变压器,通过扩散或噪音配置来统一视频和动作,同时保留单独的模式频道[45,6,14]. Omnimodule世界模型进一步扩大了一套模型化模式,但可能保留围绕共享主干线的特有预测. [25]. 几何学还被引入了世界动作模型中,例如通过由未来深度监督的几何-语义预测或轻量空间表示[19,17,37]. 这些方法表明,结合互补信号可以改进体现的世界模式。 尽管如此,这些模式往往通过界面、条件机制或特定模式参数化相连接,而不是在共同承担未来世界动态的共同代表中表达。 这提出了一个根本性的问题:在一般的世界行动模式中,多式联运统一应在哪里进行? 我们争辩说,关键不仅仅是向同一个网络提供多种模式,而是让这些模式在共同代表范围内演变,从而可以直接了解它们的共同结构。

blocks.en: We therefore propose Thinker-WM , a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, depth, and action under task-level conditioning. The central design principle is representation-level unification. Each modality is first transformed by a modality-specific encoder into a shared intermediate representation. A common Transformer stage then models their joint evolution, while modality-specific decoders render the resulting representation back into RGB, depth, or executable action. The main unification therefore occurs inside the Unified Dynamic Transformer rather than only at its input or output interfaces. Within it, visual, geometric, and action tokens interact through common attention mechanism, while task-level representations provide structured guidance for future prediction. The resulting formulation treats appearance, geometry, action, and instruction as different manifestations of a coupled world process, while retaining modality-specific interfaces where the underlying physical representations necessarily differ. Figure 1 gives an overview of the data mixture, the architecture, and the open-loop use of the same network.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议采用 " Thinker-WM " ,一种统一的多模式世界模式,在任务层面的前提下共同建立模型和生成RGB、深度和行动。 中央设计原则是代表级统一. 每种模式首先由特定模式的编码器转换为共享中间代表. 一个常见的变形器阶段然后模拟它们的联合演化,而模式特定的解码器则将由此产生的表示重新变成RGB,深度,或可执行动作. 因此,主要统一发生在统一动态变换器内部,而不仅仅出现在其输入或输出界面上. 在它内部,视觉,几何,和行动符号通过共同的注意机制来相互作用,而任务层次的表示为未来的预测提供了结构化的指导. 由此产生的提法将外观、几何、动作和指示作为偶联世界过程的不同表现,同时保留某些特定模式的界面,其基本物理表现必然不同。 图1概述了数据混合物,架构,以及同一网络的开放-loop使用.

blocks.en: This representation-level formulation also allows geometry to become an explicit component of the generated world state. Thinker-WM represents depth using the same latent and spatiotemporal organization as visual generation, allowing geometric information to participate throughout the shared generative process. Geometric supervision therefore shapes the shared representation rather than being applied only through an auxiliary prediction branch. This makes physical structure directly available to the model alongside visual appearance and action, providing complementary information about the spatial relationships that govern embodied interaction. The objective is not to treat geometry as a complete solution to physical reasoning, but to make metric structure a native signal within the world model.
blocks.zh: 这种表示级的表述方式也使得几何学成为所生成的世界状态的一个明确组成部分. 思想者-WM代表深度,使用与视觉生成相同的潜伏和瞬间组织,使几何信息能够参与整个共享基因过程. 因此,几何监督决定了共享的表示,而不是仅仅通过辅助预测分支来应用. 这使得模型在视觉外观和行动的同时,可以直接利用物理结构,提供关于所体现相互作用的空间关系的补充信息。 目标不是将几何学作为物理推理的完整解决方案,而是使公制结构成为世界模型内的本土信号.

blocks.en: A unified representation is valuable only when the training distribution captures the diversity of embodied dynamics encountered in the real world. Thinker-WM is trained from a heterogeneous mixture of general video data, publicly available robot datasets, in-house robot data, and egocentric human video. General video provides broad visual and temporal priors; robot data provides action-grounded supervision across different embodiments, environments, and tasks; and egocentric video expands coverage of real-world interactions and human motion [ 7 , 13 , 10 , 43 ] . These sources differ substantially in sensor configuration, action representation, embodiment, and annotation format. Thinker-WM therefore maps heterogeneous robot actions into a common representation at the model boundary, allowing shared dynamics to be learned across embodiments while preserving robot-specific decoding. In this way, data diversity and architectural unification reinforce each other: diverse sources broaden the distribution of world dynamics, while the shared representation provides a common space in which those dynamics can be learned.
blocks.zh: 只有在培训分配中反映现实世界中体现的动态的多样性时,统一代表性才有价值。 Thinker-WM从一般视频数据、公开的机器人数据集、内部机器人数据以及以自我为中心的人类视频等多种多样的组合中接受培训。 一般视频提供广泛的视觉和时间前科;机器人数据提供基于行动的监督,涵盖不同的表现、环境和任务;以自我为中心的视频扩大了真实世界互动和人类运动的覆盖面[7、13、10、43]。 这些来源在传感器配置、动作表现、活化和注释格式方面差别很大。 因此,思考者-WM将各种机器人动作映射成模型边界的共同代表,使共同的动力学能够跨越各种表现,同时保留机器人特有的解码. 这样,数据多样性和建筑统一相辅相成:各种来源扩大了世界动态的分布,而共同的表述则提供了一个共同的空间来学习这些动态。

blocks.en: We evaluate Thinker-WM across embodied world-model benchmarks and a range of generative settings, including action-conditioned future generation, depth generation, long-horizon rollout, trajectory transfer, video-to-action generation, and instruction-conditioned generation. These experiments examine whether a shared multimodal representation can support world prediction, geometric modeling, and action generation within a single model. Thinker-WM ranked first on EWMBench [ 12 ] , WorldOlympiad [ 42 ] and WorldArena [ 29 ] , while additional experiments demonstrate its ability to support multiple world-model and world-action conditionals within the same parameterization.
blocks.zh: 我们评价思想家-WM跨越了体现的世界模式基准和一系列基因环境,包括具有行动条件的后世、深度生成、长视野推出、轨迹转移、视频到行动生成以及具有教学条件的生成。 这些实验研究共同的多模式表述是否能够支持世界预测、几何模型和单一模型内的行动生成。 Thinker-WM在EWMBench [12],WorldOlympiad [42]和WorldArena [29] 上排名第一,而额外的实验则证明了它有能力支持同一参数化范围内的多个世界模型和世界行动条件.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are: • Representation-level multimodal unification. We introduce the Unified Dynamic Transformer in which RGB, depth, action, and task-level conditioning are lifted into a shared intermediate representation and transformed by common parameters, placing multimodal interaction inside the representation rather than only at the input or output interfaces. • Geometry as part of the generative world state. We incorporate depth as a native generative modality that shares the latent and spatiotemporal structure of visual modeling and whose supervision directly shapes the shared representation, making physical geometry an explicit component of the modeled world dynamics. • Scalable heterogeneous embodied learning. We combine general video, publicly available robot data, in-house robot data, and egocentric human video, together with a common action representation across embodiments, to provide complementary visual, geometric, and action supervision for scalable world-action modeling.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是: 代表一级的多式联运统一。 我们引入了统一动态变换器,其中RGB,深度,动作,和任务级别条件被提升为共享的中间代表并被共同参数所改变,将多模式互动置于代表内部,而不仅仅是在输入或输出界面. • 几何作为基因世界状态的一部分。 我们把深度作为一种本土基因模式,分享视觉建模的潜在和瞬息万变的结构,其监督直接塑造了共享的表达方式,使物理几何成为模拟世界动态的一个明确组成部分。 • 可伸缩的多种学习形式。 我们把一般的视频、公开的机器人数据、内部机器人数据、以自我为中心的人类视频,以及一个跨越浮雕的共同行动代表,结合起来,为可扩展的世界行动模型提供互补的视觉、几何和动作监督。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
We view world models as generative models that learn how an environment
evolves under observations, conditions, and interventions. Their role has
gradually expanded from compact predictive simulators to large-scale
generative models with broad visual priors, and more recently to models
that jointly generate future observations and executable actions. From this
perspective, we organize prior work into three stages: simulator-oriented
world models, latent and generative world models, and world models that
generate actions alongside the future. We further discuss recent efforts to
introduce explicit geometric structure into this unified formulation, which
provides the closest context for Thinker-WM.

blocks.en: 2.1 Simulator-oriented World Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 以模拟器为导向的世界模式

blocks.en:
Early world models were developed primarily as learned simulators for
model-based planning and reinforcement learning. World Models [ 8 ] compress observations into a compact latent space,
model temporal dynamics with a recurrent mixture-density network, and
enable agents to train policies inside the model’s imagined rollouts.
PlaNet and the subsequent Dreamer family [ 9 ] further
demonstrate that a learned latent dynamics model can support planning and
behavior learning without requiring the policy to interact with the real
environment at every step. DreamerV3 [ 9 ] in particular shows that a common
world-modeling recipe can operate across a broad collection of tasks and
domains under a largely fixed training configuration.

blocks.en: 2.2 Latent and Generative World Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 现代和基因世界模式

blocks.en:
Recent work increasingly treats the world model itself as a large-scale
generative model rather than a compact task-specific simulator. This shift
replaces manually designed or task-specific latent dynamics with generative
models capable of capturing richer visual structure and broader physical
priors. GAIA-1 [ 11 ] , for example, learns an action-conditioned
generative model of driving scenes from large-scale fleet data, while
Genie [ 5 ] learns a controllable latent interface directly from
large collections of video without requiring explicit action annotations.
UniSim [ 38 ] further combines image, robotics, and navigation data
to construct a general-purpose simulator whose outputs can represent the
visual consequences of both high-level instructions and low-level controls.
iVideoGPT [ 33 ] integrates action-conditioned video prediction
with visual planning and model-based reinforcement learning, while
Pandora [ 35 ] allows language-conditioned interventions throughout
a generated trajectory rather than restricting the condition to the
initial frame.

Despite their generality, however, the action interface of these models is
often indirect. Actions may be represented as latent controls, natural
language commands, or environment-specific interfaces rather than as
executable physical robot actions. In other cases, the generated visual

the model serves as a data engine whose generated embodied data improves a
separately trained policy [ 16 ] .
Thus, the generative world model provides the predictive component of
control while the executable action model remains outside the generative
process. This separation motivates the next stage of world-model
development: jointly modeling the future world and the action that
produces it.

combines pretrained experts for vision-language understanding, video

bridge video generation and robot control. This demonstrates that
large-scale video priors and action learning can be combined within a
single generative framework, while physical embodiment grounding is still

action representation is also expressed relative to the conditioning
frame, with relative position and rotation providing a more transferable
interface across robot configurations. These choices are closely related
to the setting considered in this work, where action-free egocentric video
and heterogeneous robot trajectories must coexist during training.
However, MotuBrain retains embodiment-specific physical scales rather
than explicitly registering the action statistics of different robots at a
shared model boundary, and its temporal instruction structure is primarily
episode-level rather than aligned to individual instruction segments.

A complementary line unifies video and action through diffusion noise
rather than through separate modality-specific architectures.
Diffusion Forcing [ 6 ] assigns independent noise levels

UWM [ 45 ] applies this principle to robot learning by sharing a
transformer between image and action diffusion processes, allowing the
same model to operate as a policy, a world model, or a joint
video-action model depending on the masking configuration. Diffusion
ReRoll [ 14 ] further introduces asymmetric SNR-based reweighting
for image and action losses. These methods provide a flexible probabilistic
view of world modeling with action, although action and image remain separate
diffusion channels and their embodiment-specific representations are not
the primary focus.

Another direction expands the scope of modality unification. Cosmos 3 [ 25 ] jointly models language, image, video, audio, and action
using a shared multimodal backbone, with domain-aware input and output
projections that carry each embodiment into a shared latent action space.
Ego and effector poses are encoded as frame-to-frame relative transforms,
while grasp states directly encode the current manipulation state, and
large-scale egocentric human video supplies additional pseudo-action
supervision.

Recent work has additionally introduced explicit geometric structure into
this joint generative process. GeoSem-WAM [ 19 ] augments
joint world and action learning with geometric and semantic future prediction,
showing that structured spatial information can provide action-relevant
supervision beyond RGB appearance. WAM4D [ 17 ] introduces
lightweight spatial register tokens supervised by future depth to inject

branch during action inference for efficiency. These results suggest that
metric geometry can provide a useful intermediate representation for
connecting visual dynamics and physical interaction. In these approaches,
however, geometry is primarily introduced as an auxiliary supervisory
signal or intermediate representation rather than as a modality that is
jointly generated throughout the same generative process.

DreamZero [ 39 ] provides the closest instance of the
pretrained-backbone route. It builds a robot foundation model on top of a
large image-to-video diffusion backbone and jointly denoises visual
trajectories and robot actions under a shared objective, showing that
preserving a strong visual generation prior improves downstream robot
control relative to vision-language-action baselines. Its remaining
boundaries are of a different kind: the instruction is supplied by a
frozen text encoder rather than produced by the generative process, the
model is pretrained separately for each embodiment, and its action target
stays at relative joint positions rather than a shared end-effector
representation. Zero-WAM [ 44 ] extends the same direction to
in-context human-video supervision, but keeps separate query, key, and
value projections, feed-forward networks, and output heads per modality,
so that video and action meet only inside the shared attention layers. The
two therefore share at different depths: one transformer with separated
decoders in DreamZero [ 39 ] , shared attention over separated parameters in
Zero-WAM [ 44 ] .

blocks.en: 2.4 Position of Thinker-WM
blocks.zh: 2.4 思想家的立场

blocks.en:
The progression above moves from world models as compact simulators, to
large-scale generative models with transferable visual priors, and finally
to world models that jointly predict the future world and executable
actions. Thinker-WM follows the latter formulation while
extending it in three directions. First, it preserves a pretrained
flow-matching video-generation backbone and incorporates robot and
egocentric data without reducing action-free video to an action-labeled
proxy. Second, it treats appearance, metric geometry, and action as
co-evolving outputs of a shared intermediate representation rather than
using geometry only as an auxiliary training signal. Third, it registers
heterogeneous robot actions at the model boundary using a common relative
end-effector representation and per-robot statistics, allowing different
embodiments to share the same generative space while retaining exact
robot-specific decoding.

Architecturally, Thinker-WM therefore places the main unification inside the

video, geometry, action, and language into a common latent interface,
where shared attention and feed-forward transformations model their joint
evolution. The resulting formulation treats the world model not merely as
a simulator for a downstream policy, but as a unified generative model in
which visual dynamics, physical structure, and executable action are
different manifestations of the same underlying world process.

A world model for embodied intelligence must capture more than the visual
appearance of the future. The evolution of an embodied environment is jointly
reflected in what the agent observes, the geometric structure of the scene, and
the actions that cause the observed changes. Thinker-WM therefore models RGB
video, metric depth, and robot action within a single generative framework,
rather than treating action generation as a downstream module of visual
prediction.

objective from the scene description and the intended operation, reducing
variation in prompt format across data sources and providing a consistent
semantic structure for the language encoder.
Prompt structure is further regularized during training. Redundant
occurrences of the field are merged, the order of the three fields is
randomly shuffled, and random field dropout is applied. Evaluation uses a fixed Task–Scene–Action order. These transformations encourage the model to rely on semantic
content rather than field position or the presence of a complete schema.

blocks.en: 4.1 In-House Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 住宅数据

blocks.en: In-house data provide coverage of our target embodiments, environments, and task distributions. It includes high-quality egocentric human video collected internally, spanning household, commercial, retail, and industrial scenarios. These egocentric recordings are captured with head-mounted stereo devices at 30Hz, and each frame includes hand keypoints and head pose. We further organize this egocentric corpus into 10 major categories and 20 subcategories, with the data evenly distributed across these categories. This egocentric data supplies scalable task, scene, object, and long-horizon activity diversity that robot teleoperation cannot economically reach. We also integrate high-quality real-robot data collected from UBTech robots, which provides paired visual observations and executable actions for learning practical robot dynamics and embodiment-specific action representations.
blocks.zh: 内部数据涵盖我们的目标表现、环境和任务分布。 它包括内部收集的、涵盖家庭、商业、零售和工业情景的以自我为中心的高质量人类视频。 这些以自负为中心录制的录音在30Hz被用头架立体装置所捕获,而每个相框包括手键和头姿. 我们进一步将这种自我中心体分为10个主要类别和20个子类别,数据在这些类别中分布均匀。 这种以自我为中心的数据提供可扩展的任务,场景,物体,以及机器人远程操作在经济上无法达到的长视距活动多样性. 我们还整合了从UBTech机器人所收集的高质量真机器人数据,这些数据为学习实用机器人动力学和特有化能动作表现提供了配对视觉观测和可执行动作.

blocks.en: 4.2 Internet Data
blocks.zh: 4.2 互联网数据

blocks.en: Internet data consist of open-source datasets collected from the web. General video data, including OpenVid [ 23 ] , cover diverse scenes, objects, activities, and visual dynamics, providing broad visual and temporal priors beyond the distribution of embodied datasets. Open-source robot datasets, including AgiBot [ 30 ] and RoboMIND [ 34 ] , cover diverse embodiments, environments, and manipulation tasks, offering paired visual observations and actions for learning embodied dynamics and cross-embodiment representations. RoboTwin [ 22 ] provides simulated manipulation data. Egocentric human video sources, including EgoVerse [ 27 ] and Ego4D [ 7 ] , supply scalable task, scene, object, and long-horizon activity diversity. The sources listed here are representative rather than exhaustive; additional public datasets are also included in the pretraining mixture.
blocks.zh: 互联网数据由从网络上收集的开源数据集组成. 包括"OpenVid [23]"在内的一般视频数据覆盖了不同的场景,对象,活动和视觉动态,提供了超出所包含数据集分布范围的广泛视觉和时间前传. 开放源代码机器人数据集,包括AgiBot [30]和RoboMIND [34],覆盖了不同的化身,环境和操纵任务,为学习提供了组合的视觉观测和行动,体现了动态和交叉化的表达. RoboTwin [22]提供模拟操纵数据. 以爱高中心为核心的人类视频来源,包括"EgoVerse [27]"和"Ego4D [7]",提供可伸缩的任务,场景,物体,和长视线活动多样性. 这里列出的来源具有代表性,而不是详尽无遗;附加的公共数据集也包含在预训混合物中.

blocks.en: 4.3 Depth Data
blocks.zh: 4.3 深度数据

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Depth data pipeline . We generate depth pseudo-labels for egocentric and robot videos, filter low-quality clips, and align the retained depth with RGB frames for world model training.
blocks.zh: 图7:深度数据管道 我们为以自我为中心的视频和机器人视频制作深度伪标签,过滤出低质量的片段,并将保留的深度与RGB框架相配合,用于世界模型培训.

blocks.en: To complement RGB observations with explicit geometric information, we augment egocentric and robot videos with depth pseudo-labels. We use Fast-FoundationStereo [ 32 ] to estimate depth from egocentric stereo pairs and DepthAnything3 [ 18 ] to predict depth from monocular robot videos. The resulting depth maps are aligned with the original RGB views and resized to a common resolution. We apply clip-level quality control based on temporal consistency, depth validity, and agreement with available sensor depth, discarding clips with unreliable predictions. During training, we sample synchronized RGB and depth sequences, apply logarithmic depth encoding, and encode both modalities with the same frozen VAE. Depth is then learned as an additional generative stream using flow matching, providing geometric supervision for modeling spatial structure and physical interactions.
blocks.zh: 为了用明确的几何信息来补充RGB观测,我们用深度伪标签来增加以自我为中心的机器人视频. 我们用快快的FoundationStereo [32] 来估计以自负为中心的立体对和深度任意3 [18] 从单相机视频来预测深度. 由此产生的深度图与RGB的原始观点一致并被调整为共同分辨率. 我们根据时间一致性、深度有效性和与现有传感器深度的一致、不可靠的预测而采用剪接级质量控制。 在训练期间,我们抽样同步RGB和深度序列,应用对数深度编码,并用同一种被冻结的VAE编码两种模式. 然后用流相匹配法将深度作为额外的基因流来学习,为模型空间结构和物理相互作用提供几何监督.

blocks.en: 5.2 Quality Control and Gating
blocks.zh: 5.2 质量控制和配给

blocks.en: Quality control is implemented as a set of boundaries along the sample path, each with different granularity and cost. Offline gates operate on whole Episodes and windows, rejecting timelines with non-finite values or magnitudes beyond per-source guards, filtering stationary windows, and excluding Episodes shorter than a training window. Egocentric recordings receive an additional filter that removes windows dominated by camera self-motion, keeping only start positions whose rotation and translation stay within calibrated thresholds. Online gates at load time validate action and state ranges before video decoding, retry missing or corrupt videos against a bounded number of alternates, and blacklist persistent failures. Batch-level checks validate shapes, value ranges, finiteness, and the model input contract; a genuinely absent modality is marked rather than filled. At the step level, samples with extreme unified-action magnitudes have their loss weight zeroed, non-finite values are replaced before zeroing, and any step affected by non-finite parameters, loss, or gradients is skipped. The depth stream carries its own gates: a selection file marks usable Episodes, depth frames are checked against video frames for alignment, unreadable depth is marked absent and loses its loss share, and depths are clamped to the codec range.
blocks.zh: 质量控制作为一组沿样地路径的边界实施,每条边界具有不同的颗粒性和成本. 离线出站闸机运行于整个Episode和窗口上,拒绝带有非无限值或超出per-source卫视的等分级的时段,过滤固定窗口,排除Episode比训练窗口更短. Egocentral records接收到一个额外的过滤器,可以去除以相机自动为主的窗口,只保留起步位置,其旋转和翻译停留在被校正的阈值以内. 装入时的在线闸门验证动作和状态范围,然后视频解码,重试缺失或腐败的视频,以对抗被限制的替代人数,黑名单持续失败. 批量级检查验证了形状、价值范围、有限程度和模型输入合同;真正不存在的模式是标记而不是填充的。 在步骤层面,具有极端统一作用量级的样本会将其减重为零,非无限值被替换后再被零去,任何受非无限参数,损失,或梯度影响的步骤都会被跳过. 深度流自带出出出门:可使用Episodes的选取文件标记,深度帧会对照视频帧进行校正检查,无法读取的深度会被标记出缺失并丢失其损失份额,深度会被夹入编码范围.

blocks.en: 5.4 Load Balancing across Ranks
blocks.zh: 5.4 跨等级平衡负载

blocks.en: In synchronous training, all ranks must update the same parameters at the same step. If ranks train different branch subsets, the reduction operates over different tensor sets and can deadlock under ZeRO-1. We therefore make the function mode a pure function of the step number, sampled from configured proportions with a generator seeded only by that step, persisted with the checkpoint, and advanced identically by every rank. This guarantees agreement across ranks and across restarts. The same reasoning requires identical token layouts: windows are cut to fixed lengths so no padding is needed and every rank carries the same number of tokens. Figure 10 illustrates the arrangement.
blocks.zh: 在同步训练中,所有队伍必须在同一步骤上更新相同的参数. 如果排队训练出不同的分支子集,减分会运行于不同的收分机上,并可以在ZeRO-1下陷入僵局. 因此,我们使功能模式成为步骤数的纯函数,从配置比例中抽取一个仅由该步骤播种的发电机,坚持检查站,并按每个级别同样推进。 这保证了跨级别和跨重新启动的协议。 同样的推理需要相同的令牌布局:窗口被切为固定长度,所以不需要贴花,而每个等级都带有相同的令牌数量. 图10说明了这一安排。

blocks.en: Source assignment offers two deterministic schedules. The default assigns the same source to every rank at a given step, keeping batches internally consistent. The alternative distributes rank slots across sources in proportion to their weights, mixing the corpus more finely at the risk of stragglers. Both require no inter-rank communication. Losses are averaged across ranks, and non-finite and outlier signals are reduced so that a condition seen by one rank is acted on by all.

blocks.en: 5.5 Evaluation Orchestration
blocks.zh: 5.5 评价

blocks.en: Evaluation runs every fixed number of steps on a fixed set of samples, with deterministic assignment to ranks derived from the same weights as the training mixture. To avoid competing with training for GPUs, a background process decodes evaluation clips into a shared-storage cache and writes a completion manifest. The foreground evaluation only reads the cache, so prepared evaluations take seconds and never occupy a GPU needed by training. The cache is content-keyed and reused across restarts and runs; an evaluation whose cache is not ready is skipped rather than stalling training. Out-of-memory shards are rerun with smaller micro-batches, keeping the evaluated set complete, and results join the same logging channel as training metrics.

blocks.en: 6 Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 6 培训战略

blocks.en: Thinker-WM supports multiple control modes and is trained on heterogeneous data sources. Large-scale general video supplies broad visual and temporal priors [ 8 , 5 , 35 ] ; real robot recordings provide embodiment-specific visual statistics and the action supervision on which the conditionals of Eq. ( 3 ) depend; egocentric human video supplies scalable task, scene, and object diversity that robot teleoperation cannot economically reach [ 4 , 26 ] . The Data Factory provides the execution substrate, and this section specifies how these sources are combined into a staged curriculum.
blocks.zh: Thinker-WM支持多控制模式,并接受关于多数据源的培训. 大规模一般视频提供广泛的视觉和时间前科[8,5,35];真实的机器人录音提供特异性的视觉统计数据和Eq.(3)条件所依赖的行动监督;以自我为中心的人类视频提供可扩展的任务,场景,以及机器人远程操作在经济上无法达到的物体多样性[4,26]. 数据厂提供执行底板,本节具体说明如何将这些来源合并成一个分阶段的课程.

blocks.en: 6.1 Staged Training Curriculum
blocks.zh: 6.1 分阶段培训课程

blocks.en: Training across all data distributions from the outset can destabilize optimization, as heterogeneous objectives compete for the capacity of the shared model and may pull the representation toward dominant training distributions. Fully sequential training, in contrast, risks catastrophic forgetting of capabilities acquired in earlier stages [ 20 , 15 ] . To balance acquisition and retention, Thinker-WM adopts a staged curriculum with lightweight rehearsal, progressively introducing new data distributions and capabilities while maintaining a small replay stream from earlier stages [ 28 , 2 ] . The training distribution of stage s s is 𝒟 s = ( 1 − ϵ s ) ​ 𝒟 s main + ϵ s ​ 𝒟 s replay , ϵ s ≪ 1 , \mathcal{D}_{s}\;=\;(1-\epsilon_{s})\,\mathcal{D}_{s}^{\mathrm{main}}\;+\;\epsilon_{s}\,\mathcal{D}_{s}^{\mathrm{replay}},\qquad\epsilon_{s}\ll 1, (19) where 𝒟 s main \mathcal{D}_{s}^{\mathrm{main}} carries the new capability and 𝒟 s replay \mathcal{D}_{s}^{\mathrm{replay}} samples all previously aligned distributions. Each stage therefore mixes in a small fraction of the data from the preceding stage, so that capabilities accumulate rather than overwrite. Stages are ordered so that shared representations stabilize before downstream modules couple into them. Table 3 summarizes the data, updated scope, and installed capability of each stage.

blocks.en: Stage 0 is the pretrained Wan2.2 TI2V-5B backbone [ 31 ] , which supplies the broad visual and temporal prior and is not trained here. Stage 1 introduces open-source robot recordings and egocentric human video, training only the video pathway to adapt the inherited prior to first-person embodied observations; a small fraction of Stage 0 data is replayed to preserve scene, lighting, and camera-motion diversity. Stage 2 turns the video-only model into a joint video–action model on curated robot and egocentric data, introducing the action stream and the geometric stream together, with the planning condition providing a shared conditioning signal across branches. Stage 3 specializes the model to the target robot using embodiment-specific recordings and accurate geometric supervision; the earlier stages are replayed so that the shared backbone and previously acquired capabilities are preserved. Overall, the curriculum follows a progression of inheritance , integration , and specialization .
blocks.zh: 0阶段是经过预训的Wan2.2 TI2V-5B骨干[31],它供给了宽视和时间先发,不在这里训练. 第1阶段引入了开源机器人录音和以自我为中心的人类视频,只培训视频路径来适应第一人称内含观测之前继承的;第0阶段数据的一小部分被重放以保存场景,照明和相机运动的多样性. 第2阶段将只使用视频的模型变成一个关于自制机器人和以自我为中心的数据的联合视频-动作模型,将动作流和几何流一起引入,同时规划条件提供跨分支的共享调节信号. 第3阶段将模型专用于目标机器人,使用特有化身的录音和准确的几何监督;更早期的阶段被重放,这样共享的主干和先前获得的能力得以保存. 总的来说,课程沿袭着继承、融合和专业化的发展。

blocks.en: 6.2 Stage-wise Parameter and Geometry Schedule
blocks.zh: 6.2 相位参数和几何表

blocks.en: We initialize from the Wan2.2 TI2V-5B backbone [ 31 ] and reuse its pretrained blocks, patch embeddings, modulation layers, and positional geometry across all three architectural depths (Section 3.2 ). Stage 0 leaves these weights untouched. Stage 1 updates the visual pathway only, adapting the inherited prior to robot-view and first-person statistics without disturbing branches that have no counterpart in the pretrained model. From Stage 2 onward, all trainable parameters are active: the action tower, the geometric pathway, and the shared UDT are optimized jointly. The frozen components remain fixed throughout, as the VAE and the VLM keep their pretrained weights.
blocks.zh: 我们从Wan2.2 TI2V-5B主干线上初始化[31],并重新使用其预先训练的块,补丁嵌入,调制层,以及所有三个建筑深度的位置几何(第3.2节)。 第0阶段使这些重量保持不变。 第1阶段仅更新可视路径,调整机器人-视图和第一人称统计之前的继承,而不扰动在预训模型中没有对应的分支. 从第2阶段起,所有可训练参数都活跃:动作塔,几何路径,共享的UDT被联合优化. 由于VAE和VLM保持了预先训练的重量,被冻结的部件始终固定不变。

blocks.en: Geometry enters in Stage 2 and is integrated into the shared representation so that the model jointly predicts future observations, geometry, and actions. While the mixture is dominated by data with coarse or partial depth annotation, the geometric channel is one-way: geometry reads appearance and action, but neither reads geometry, so the geometric objective shapes the shared weights only through its own loss gradient. Once training is restricted to datasets with accurate depth, which in this curriculum is the target-robot fine-tuning stage, the remaining direction is opened so that appearance and action also read the geometric stream (Figures 3 and 4 ).
blocks.zh: 几何进入了第二阶段,并被集成到共享的表示中,以便模型共同预测未来的观测,几何,和行动. 虽然混合物以有粗深或部分深度注释的数据为主,但几何通道是单向的:几何读取外观和动作,而两相不读取几何,因此几何客观只能通过自身损失梯度来塑造共享的权重. 一旦培训仅限于准确深度的数据集,在本课程中,该数据集是目标-机器人微调阶段,剩下的方向就会被打开,使外观和行动也读取了几何流(图3和图4.).

Mode assignment is made once per optimization step for the whole batch, seeded by the global step index and identical across all data-parallel ranks, so every rank computes gradients for the same set of branches and the sharded optimizer remains consistent. These proportions belong to the training configuration and can be revised without touching the architecture.

blocks.en: 7 Motion Probe
blocks.zh: 7 运动探测

blocks.en: Chapters 3 and 6 establish that Thinker-WM jointly models RGB, depth, and action through a shared Unified Dynamics Transformer (UDT). A natural question is whether the shared representation truly captures cross-modal coupling, or merely processes modalities in parallel. We introduce Motion Probe , a lightweight diagnostic module that evaluates whether motion information can be recovered from the shared video representation, thereby providing direct evidence for the effectiveness of the UDT. Motion probe’s effect is evaluated in Section 8.2.4 .
blocks.zh: 第3章和第6章规定,思想家-WM通过共享的"统一动态变换器"(UDT),联合模型RGB,深度,和行动. 一个自然的问题是,共同代表制是真正能够体现跨模式的结合,还是仅仅同时处理模式。 我们引入 Motion Probe, 一个轻量级的诊断模块, 第8.2.4节评估了运动探测器的效果。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Overview of Motion Probe. (a) Offline visual motion teacher construction: SpatialTrackerV2 extracts 3D point trajectories from ground-truth RGB video, motion-aware filtering and median aggregation produce a robust visual center trajectory, and a per-window Sim(3) transform aligns it with the recorded end-effector motion. The aligned teacher is frozen and cached. (b) Probing the frozen UDT: a lightweight Motion Head predicts end-effector displacement from the shared video representation. The UDT weights remain frozen, and only the Motion Head is trained. Low probe error indicates that the shared representation encodes action-relevant motion.

blocks.en: 7.1 Probe Design and Offline Motion Teacher

blocks.en: The probe rests on a simple logic: if the UDT truly unifies appearance and action, the video tokens should carry sufficient motion information to reconstruct end-effector displacement aligned with the executed action, even without action-specific supervision on the video pathway. We test this by attaching a lightweight Motion Head to the frozen UDT video tokens. The head is deliberately small—spatial pooling followed by temporal regression—so that its capacity cannot compensate for missing motion information in the shared representation. The UDT weights are kept frozen throughout the probe, and only the Motion Head is trained.
blocks.zh: 探测基于一个简单的逻辑:如果UDT真正统一了外表和行动,视频符号应携带足够的运动信息来重建与被执行行动一致的终端效应移位,即使没有针对特定行动对视频路径的监督. 我们通过在被冻结的UDT视频符号上 加上一个轻量级运动头来测试这个 头部故意是小的 -- -- 空间集合,然后是时间回落 -- -- 因此其能力无法补偿共享代表中缺少的运动信息。 UDT的重量在整个探测器中一直被冻结,只有运动头被训练出.

blocks.en: The probe is interpreted as a measurement, not as a performance improvement. If the frozen UDT video representation already encodes action-relevant motion, a small head should recover displacement with low error; if recovery fails, the shared representation does not carry sufficient motion structure for downstream use. A low probe error therefore provides direct evidence that the UDT has learned a genuinely unified representation in which appearance and action are coupled, rather than merely processed in parallel. The probe introduces no new training stage, no modification to the backbone, and no additional generation branch; its value lies in the representational evidence it provides.
blocks.zh: 探测器被解释为测量,而不是性能的改进. 如果被冻结的UDT视频代表已经编码了与动作相关的运动,一个小头应该以低误差恢复移位;如果恢复失败,共享代表不能携带足够的运动结构供下游使用. 因此,低度探险错误提供了直接证据,证明UDT已经了解到一种真正统一的代表性,即外表和行动是相配的,而不仅仅是平行处理的。 探测器没有引入新的训练阶段,也没有对骨干进行修改,也没有额外的生成分支;其价值在于它所提供的代表证据.

blocks.en: 8.1.1 EWMBench Evaluation

classifier-free guidance scale of 5.0. Since the benchmark computes its metrics
at 30 FPS, generated results are upsampled from 5 FPS to 30 FPS so that the
comparison follows the protocol on which the benchmark is defined.

blocks.en:
We further evaluate on WorldArena [ 29 ] Track-1, a
simulation-based benchmark for open-loop embodied video generation. Unlike
EWMBench and WorldOlympiad, which are built on real-robot manipulation videos,
WorldArena provides controlled simulated environments with diverse task
configurations and interaction dynamics. The track assesses visual appearance,
temporal consistency, physical plausibility, 3D geometric fidelity, and
compliance with task instructions and action conditions. Because Dynamic
Degree, Flow Score, and Motion Smoothness are highly sensitive to frame rate
and temporal sampling density, we exclude these three motion-related metrics
and adopt the unweighted mean of the remaining twelve metrics as the core
comparison metric, following the official benchmark recommendation as these three motion metrics suffer from frame-sampling exploitation bugs. The retained metrics cover visual quality, content
consistency, physics adherence, 3D accuracy, and controllability: Image
Quality , Aesthetic Quality , JEPA Similarity , Subject Consistency , Background Consistency , Photometric Consistency , Interaction Quality, Trajectory , Accuracy , Depth Accuracy , Perspectivity , Instruction Following , and Semantic Alignment .

blocks.en: 8.2 Ablation and Analysis
blocks.zh: 8.2 分析和分析

blocks.en:
We conduct a set of controlled experiments to examine the functional behavior of
Thinker-WM and the role of its shared multimodal representation. The experiments
address four complementary questions. First, does the model actually consume an
action sequence when it is provided as a condition? Second, does depth contribute
to downstream control beyond improving geometric prediction, and does the direction
of RGB–depth interaction matter? Third, can the six function modes share the same
UDT parameters without introducing substantial optimization conflict? Finally, can
additional motion-level supervision improve action prediction without degrading the
existing video representation?

determine the predicted future rather than merely coexisting with an independently
generated video. We therefore compare the standard joint-generation mode with an
action-conditioned mode in which the ground-truth action sequence is provided as a
clean condition and the language prompt is removed. Both settings use the same
network parameters, so the comparison isolates the effect of conditioning the video
generation process on an explicit action trajectory.

blocks.en: 8.2.4 Motion Probe Evaluation

blocks.en:
Motion probing evaluates whether action-relevant motion information is
recoverable from the shared video representation. This analysis complements
the gradient-compatibility analysis in Section 8.2.3 :
while the latter examines whether auxiliary training objectives interfere
during optimization, the motion probe assesses the action-related information
available in the learned representation.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the probe on a held-out set of 96 AgiBot windows. For each UDT
checkpoint, we freeze the video representation and train the same probing-head
architecture under a consistent training protocol. The probe predicts
executed end-effector displacement from the frozen video representation alone,
and its accuracy is measured by action mean squared error (MSE). By keeping
the representation frozen and the probing protocol fixed, this evaluation
measures how readily action-relevant motion information can be extracted from
the learned features, rather than how well the representation adapts to the
probe objective.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 9 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This work presented Thinker-WM , a unified multimodal world model that jointly models RGB, depth, and robot action within a shared intermediate representation. Modality-specific encoders and decoders preserve the distinct structure of each modality, while a shared Unified Dynamics Transformer (UDT) models their joint evolution with a single set of weights. This design supports multiple world-action functions under one parameterization, including joint video-action generation, world modeling, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. Trained on approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, about 4K hours with aligned depth, Thinker-WM uses a staged curriculum with replay to stabilize shared representations and specialize to the deployed robot. Across benchmarks, it achieves the best Overall score on EWMBench ( 4.66 4.66 ), ranks first on WorldOlympiad Robotics with an All score of 0.740 0.740 , and obtains the highest 12-metric EWMScore of 71.73 71.73 on WorldArena Track-1. Supplying a recorded action sequence as a clean condition improves Overall from 4.66 4.66 to 5.03 5.03 , with HSD increasing from 0.5638 0.5638 to 0.7369 0.7369 and nDTW from 0.7102 0.7102 to 0.8736 0.8736 . Additional experiments show that bidirectional RGB-depth interaction raises closed-loop success on RoboTwin from 60.0 % 60.0\% to 75.0 % 75.0\% , and that the frozen video representation contains recoverable action-relevant motion information. These results support representation-level unification as a viable foundation for embodied world-action modeling, while also highlighting the need for further validation in real-world closed-loop settings.
blocks.zh: 这部作品展示了"智者-WM"(Thinker-WM),一个统一的多模式世界模型,在一个共享的中间代表中,将RGB,深度,和机器人动作联合模型. 模式特异性编码器和解码器保留了每一种模式的不同结构,而一个共享的"统一动态变换器"(UDT)则用一集权重来模拟其联合演化. 这种设计在一个参数化下支持多种世界行动功能,包括联合视频-行动生成,世界建模,政策推论,行动有条件的生成,视频-行动生成,反向动态. 以自负为中心视频约20K小时,机器人数据约10K小时,模拟数据约1K小时,深度一致的约4K小时,思克-WM使用一个有重播功能的舞台课程来稳定共享表达,并专攻被部署的机器人. 纵观基准,它以EWMBench(4.66 4.66分)获得最佳总分,以0.740 0.740分的成绩在世界奥林匹克机器人赛上名列前茅,并在世界阿雷纳赛道1上获得71.73 71.73分的最高12度EWMS分. 作为清洁条件提供记录的动作序列总体改善,从4.66 4.66到5.03 5.03,HSD从0.5638 0.5638增加到0.7369 0.7369,NDTW从0.7102 0.7102增加到0.8736 0.8736。 更多实验显示双向RGB深度互动提升了RoboTwin上的闭路成功率从60.0% 60.0%到75.0% 75.0%,被冻结的视频表现包含可回收的与动作相关的运动信息. 这些成果支持将代表一级的统一作为体现的世界行动模式的可行基础,同时也强调需要在现实世界的封闭式落地环境中进一步验证。

blocks.en: Several directions remain open. First, although Thinker-WM achieves promising closed-loop control in simulation (e.g., RoboTwin), its effectiveness as a closed-loop policy on real robots remains to be established. Conducting real-world closed-loop manipulation experiments, evaluating robustness to real-world perturbations, and investigating sim-to-real transfer of the shared action interface are critical next steps. Second, geometric supervision covers only a subset of the training mixture; extending depth-aware learning to larger collections of egocentric and general video could further strengthen physical representation learning. Third, long-horizon generation is currently performed through inference-time autoregressive rollout; training directly on model-generated trajectories and quantitatively evaluating long-horizon drift remain open. Finally, scaling the model and training mixture, understanding how the geometric channel, data composition, and training curriculum should evolve with scale, and optimizing the sampling ratios of the six function modes under a fixed optimization budget are additional directions for future study.
blocks.zh: 若干方向仍然开放。 首先,尽管"智者-WM"在模拟中实现了有希望的闭路控制(如RoboTwin),但其作为对真机器人的闭路政策的有效性仍有待确立. 开展现实世界闭路操纵实验,评价稳健性到现实世界扰动,并调查共享行动界面的正向实际转移,是接下来的关键步骤. 第二,几何监督只涵盖培训混合物的一个子集;将深度认知学习扩大到更大的自负和一般视频集合,可以进一步加强实际表现学习。 第三,目前通过推论时间自动推开来进行长视距的生成;直接进行模型产生的轨迹和定量评估长视距漂移的培训仍然开放。 最后,扩大模型和培训混合,了解几何通道、数据组成和培训课程应如何随规模而演变,在固定优化预算下优化六个功能模式的抽样比率,是今后研究的又一方向。
